name: GearBox Gear Board
summary: Parts and kits for a modular gear board: spur gears on ball bearings, interlocking pegboard tiles, cranks, motor mounts and mechanisms, in three sizes.
credits: GearBox by DrFlGd: its OpenSCAD library, part table and kit catalog, ported directly. Gears by BOSL2 (BSD-2-Clause). Rendered by OpenSCAD (GPL-2.0-or-later), loaded as a separate program.
author: DrFlGd
